levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن حوشب

notes: The first route ends at «ح»; the second, started by «حدثني», writes its own names in full, so the shared tail is null
The second route's «هشام الدستوائي» is written as such and not merged with the bare «هشام» of the first (rule 9)
The Companion أنس is the last link; «ولقد سمعته يقول» is his own account
